name: @pixie-agent/forge
description: Source-available AI application generation and hosting platform

scripts.bootstrap: npm ci && npm --prefix web ci && npm --prefix agent ci && npm --prefix agent/template ci
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run i18n:check && npm run build && npm --prefix agent run build && npm --prefix agent/template run build
scripts.dev: mkdir -p web/dist && ([ -f web/dist/index.html ] || printf '<!doctype html><title>Forge</title>' > web/dist/index.html) && wrangler dev
scripts.dev:agent: set -a && . ./agent/.env && set +a && WORKSPACE_TEMPLATE_DIR="$PWD/agent/template" npm --prefix agent run dev
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && npm --prefix web run typecheck && npm --prefix agent run typecheck
scripts.db:migrate:analytics:staging: yes | wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --env staging --file=schema.migrate-analytics.sql
scripts.db:migrate:showcase:staging: yes | wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --env staging --file=schema.migrate-showcase.sql
scripts.db:migrate:free-minimax:staging: yes | wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --env staging --file=schema.migrate-free-minimax.staging.sql
scripts.db:migrate:api-key-env:staging: yes | wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --env staging --file=schema.migrate-api-key-env.sql
scripts.db:migrate:glm-tokens:staging: yes | wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --env staging --file=schema.migrate-glm-max-tokens.sql
scripts.db:migrate:checkpoint:staging: yes | wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --env staging --file=schema.migrate-checkpoint.sql
scripts.agent:deploy:prod: gcloud run deploy forge-agent --source agent --region us-central1 --timeout 3600 --concurrency 1 --min-instances 0 --max-instances 5 --cpu 1 --memory 1Gi --allow-unauthenticated --set-env-vars LLM_BASE_URL=https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic,LLM_MODEL=deepseek-flash,PI_LLM_API=anthropic-messages,PI_PROVIDER_ID=forge,PI_MODEL_REASONING=true,AGENT_MAX_RUN_MS=1500000,WORKSPACE_ROOT=/tmp/forge-agent --set-secrets LLM_API_KEY=llm-api-key:latest,LLM_API_KEY_DEEPSEEK=llm-api-key:latest,LLM_API_KEY_GLM=llm-api-key-free:latest,LLM_API_KEY_MINIMAX=llm-api-key-minimax:latest,AGENT_SECRET=agent-secret:latest
scripts.agent:deploy:staging: gcloud run deploy forge-agent-staging --source agent --region us-central1 --timeout 3600 --concurrency 1 --min-instances 0 --max-instances 1 --cpu 1 --memory 1Gi --allow-unauthenticated --set-env-vars LLM_BASE_URL=https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4,LLM_MODEL=glm-5.3-flash,PI_LLM_API=openai-completions,PI_PROVIDER_ID=forge,PI_MODEL_REASONING=true,PI_THINKING_FORMAT=zai,PI_SUPPORTS_DEVELOPER_ROLE=false,PI_MODEL_INPUT_IMAGE=true,AGENT_MAX_RUN_MS=1500000,WORKSPACE_ROOT=/tmp/forge-agent --set-secrets LLM_API_KEY=llm-api-key-staging:latest,LLM_API_KEY_GLM=llm-api-key-staging:latest,LLM_API_KEY_MINIMAX=llm-api-key-minimax-staging:latest,AGENT_SECRET=agent-secret-staging:latest
scripts.agent:deploy:free:prod: gcloud run deploy forge-agent-free --source agent --region us-central1 --timeout 3600 --concurrency 8 --no-cpu-throttling --min-instances 0 --max-instances 1 --cpu 1 --memory 1Gi --allow-unauthenticated --set-env-vars LLM_BASE_URL=https://api.minimaxi.com/anthropic,LLM_MODEL=MiniMax-M3.1-Flash,PI_LLM_API=anthropic-messages,PI_PROVIDER_ID=forge,PI_MODEL_REASONING=true,AGENT_MAX_RUN_MS=1500000,AGENT_QUEUE_CONCURRENCY=2,WORKSPACE_ROOT=/tmp/forge-agent --set-secrets LLM_API_KEY=llm-api-key-minimax:latest,LLM_API_KEY_MINIMAX=llm-api-key-minimax:latest,LLM_API_KEY_GLM=llm-api-key-free:latest,AGENT_SECRET=agent-secret:latest
scripts.agent:deploy:free:staging: gcloud run deploy forge-agent-free-staging --source agent --region us-central1 --timeout 3600 --concurrency 8 --no-cpu-throttling --min-instances 0 --max-instances 1 --cpu 1 --memory 1Gi --allow-unauthenticated --set-env-vars LLM_BASE_URL=https://api.minimaxi.com/anthropic,LLM_MODEL=MiniMax-M3.1-Flash,PI_LLM_API=anthropic-messages,PI_PROVIDER_ID=forge,PI_MODEL_REASONING=true,PI_MODEL_INPUT_IMAGE=true,AGENT_MAX_RUN_MS=1500000,AGENT_QUEUE_CONCURRENCY=2,WORKSPACE_ROOT=/tmp/forge-agent --set-secrets LLM_API_KEY=llm-api-key-minimax-staging:latest,LLM_API_KEY_MINIMAX=llm-api-key-minimax-staging:latest,LLM_API_KEY_GLM=llm-api-key-staging:latest,AGENT_SECRET=agent-secret-staging:latest
